mapper.sql: ar.user_id=#{userId} AND q.status=1 AND (q.resume_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resume r WHERE r.id=q.resume_id AND r.status=1)) AND (q.is_public=1 OR q.owner_id=#{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_record ar JOIN question q ON q.id=ar.question_id WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalAnswered",COALESCE(SUM(ar.is_correct),0) AS "correctCount" FROM answer_record ar JOIN question q ON q.id=ar.question_id WHERE

SELECT q.category_id AS "categoryId",c.name AS "name",COUNT(*) AS "total",COALESCE(SUM(ar.is_correct),0) AS "correct" FROM answer_record ar JOIN question q ON q.id=ar.question_id LEFT JOIN question_category c ON c.id=q.category_id WHERE GROUP BY q.category_id,c.name ORDER BY q.category_id
